summary_md:
# Världens bästa småbolag – förvaltarna ser köplägen

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-10-12  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A Börslunch panel of three small-cap fund managers (Christoffer Alnemark of SEB, Niklas Larsson and Adam Nyström of Lancelot) argues that quality small caps, overshadowed by AI speculation and the interest-rate debate, are trading at attractive valuations. They favour exposure to power grids, electrification, infrastructure, banks and discounted Norwegian real estate. They flag oil, geopolitics, illiquidity and market short-termism as risks, and see selective buying opportunities in Europe, the UK, Norway, France and AI-sold-off software names.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ENTRA — Entra | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Guest owns it and has bought all the way down; 45% discount, mostly government tenants, no new construction, potential to copy Castellum's sell-and-buy-back approach.

#### Reasoning

The guest manager calls Entra 'Castellum on steroids'. It trades at about 90 NOK against a 210 NOK bid from five years ago and a roughly 45% discount to NAV. Construction costs are up 30%, so supply is fixed. Government tenants make up 55-60%, and an oil-driven Norwegian economy supports Oslo and Bergen. Selling assets at book value (Trondheim 2024 precedent) and buying back shares could unlock value.

#### Sell Triggers

- if asset sales at book value fail to materialise
- if Castellum/Balder ownership blocks capital allocation
- if Norwegian rates rise sharply

> *"Vi tycker att Entra är ett Castellum på steroider."*

---

### 🟢 JYSK — Jyske Bank | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Raised profit guidance; the guest expects earnings momentum to accelerate in Q3/Q4 and likes the bank's acquisition and cost-out potential.

#### Reasoning

After the guidance upgrade to DKK 4.7-5.2bn, the guest says bank earnings momentum will accelerate with Euribor and ECB developments. Jyske integrated Handelsbanken Denmark well and can improve further. The guest admits being long banks is close to a consensus view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rate environment turns and net interest income falls
- if integration benefits stall

> *"Men vi gillar Jyske och vi gillar de videosylkratiska möjligheterna bolaget har."*

---

### 🟢 RNWH — Renew Holdings | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Adam's largest holding and also owned by SEB's Europe fund; about 13x earnings, net cash, exposure to UK rail and grid infrastructure.

#### Reasoning

The company maintains critical UK infrastructure. Rail spending is no longer declining and grid investment is booming. The stock fell 50% on framework-contract delays while earnings still grew, and is still below its peak. A valuation of about 13x P/E with net cash is attractive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if framework contract delays recur
- if UK rail/grid spending is cut

> *"Men den värderas kanske 13 gånger vinst, den har nettokassa och växer ett par procent organiskt per år. Vi gillar den också."*

---

### 🟢 MIR — Mirion Technologies | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Held by the guest; regulated nuclear sensor moat, diversified into medtech and defence; present in 90% of Western nuclear plants.

#### Reasoning

Regulation keeps out low-cost competition and the company has a strong acquisition record. Nuclear new-build has not started yet, so growth lies far ahead. The guest notes the share has already risen sharply from 6 USD.

#### Sell Triggers

- if nuclear new-build programmes are delayed or cancelled
- if valuation runs ahead of delivery

> *"Och det är också ett bolag som jag gillar för att i och med att man har exponering mot olika typer av sektorer"*

---

### 🟢 DSG — Descartes Systems | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Sold off in the AI software panic, but its logistics-hub position, proprietary data and AI as a tool support it.

#### Reasoning

The guest argues the market sold first and asked questions later. Descartes has data AI cannot replicate and customer lock-in, and can use AI to cut development costs.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI disrupts its logistics network position
- if customer churn rises

> *"sitter man som Descartes på en väldigt stark position i sitt ekosystem, man har väldigt mycket data som AI inte kan replikera"*

---

### 🟠 DPLM — Diploma | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Serial acquirer delivering on aerospace and electrification tailwinds; up nearly 80% in a year.

#### Reasoning

The guest presents it as an example of a non-AI business model that works. Strong momentum but a high multiple, and no explicit statement of ownership.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth slows
- if acquisition returns decline

> *"Diploma är en serieförvärvare som är välbekant för svenska tittare men som lyckats positionera sig oerhört väl"*

---

### 🟢 FERGR — Ferrari Group | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Guest holding presented as a value case: very low valuation, strong balance sheet, modest organic growth plus acquisitions.

#### Reasoning

This Italian valuables-logistics niche company, a smaller competitor to Loomis, combines a low valuation with a strong balance sheet and bolt-on acquisitions.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth turns negative
- if balance sheet weakens via large M&A

> *"Väldigt låg värdering. Ingen snabbväxare, men växer lite organiskt."*

---

### 🟠 CAST — Castellum | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Back-to-basics strategy of asset sales and buybacks works; up about 12% YTD against a sector down 20%.

#### Reasoning

Cited by the guest as proof that selling at book value and buying back shares at a 40-50% discount creates value. It is used as a benchmark, not an explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if buyback programme halts
- if asset sales below book value

> *"Så det är uppenbart att det här reptricket fungerar."*

---
